Hungarian city-area membership catalogue
Forrás / Source: Központi Statisztikai Hivatal (KSH)
https://www.ksh.hu/teruleti_szamjel_menu
https://www.ksh.hu/docs/osztalyozasok/teruleti_szamjel/teruleti_szamjelrendszer_struktura_elemei_2026.xlsx
Source retrieved 2026-11-06; SHA-256 36927d2798ea709f8239d806c9a84881524395f3d6f11dfdd756cc662776e1a5.
Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0)
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
KSH terms: https://www.ksh.hu/copyright
Changes: selected the 24 city-centered groups, excluded non-settlement rows and
the non-city-centered Balaton group; matched names to the application catalogue,
combined Budapest's center and sectors, and generated application IDs/count labels.
Only public registry membership facts are reused; no KSH logo or scholarly article is copied.

Hungarian county membership catalogue
Forrás / Source: Központi Statisztikai Hivatal (KSH)
https://www.ksh.hu/docs/osztalyozasok/teruleti_szamjel/teruleti_szamjelrendszer_struktura_elemei_2026.xlsx
Source retrieved 2026-11-06; SHA-256 36927d2798ea709f8239d806c9a84881524395f3d6f11dfdd756cc662776e1a5.
Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0)
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
KSH terms: https://www.ksh.hu/copyright
Changes: matched all 3155 application municipality names to their NUTS 2016
county/Budapest identifiers; generated 20 region choices and displayed county
names with the current vármegye suffix. No coordinates are included.


Hungarian neighborhood search catalogue

The compiled search catalogue contains 4,308 named areas with stable application
IDs across 617 municipalities. Names, documented aliases and selected geometries
are compiled from OpenStreetMap, municipal maps/documents and derived research
records. It is not an exclusively OpenStreetMap or exclusively official dataset.

OpenStreetMap-derived data: © OpenStreetMap contributors.
OpenStreetMap data is made available under the Open Data Commons Open Database
License (ODbL) 1.0:
https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright
https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/1-0/

Other source maps and documents retain their own source-specific terms and
attribution. The source archive preserves per-feature source references,
licence/attribution metadata where recorded, original source properties, selected
source and alternative variants, method, uncertainty and geometry fingerprints.
The application metadata and boundary package are generated from that archive;
source polygons and stable IDs are preserved, while aliases and display labels
are adapted for the application.

Some boundaries are map/text estimates or named land-use footprints, and some
records describe historical areas or broader area groups. These are approximate
search boundaries, not a guarantee of current official boundaries, exact address
classification or complete national coverage. Differently named areas may overlap.

Source archive: data/neighborhoods/search-areas.geojson.gz
SHA-256 (compressed source archive):
367af069d58c60e171d189e23673fe20fd5cef51792769c161c3eccb87321e4d

Public source data, per-feature provenance and supporting source records:
https://github.com/st-agnes/ingatlan/tree/main/data/neighborhoods
Catalogue methods and limitations:
https://github.com/st-agnes/ingatlan/blob/main/docs/NEIGHBORHOOD-SEARCH-DATA.md


Hungarian postal street catalogue
Forrás / Source: Magyar Posta Zrt., Partner Extra, Országos utcalista.
https://www.posta.hu/partnerextra
https://www.posta.hu/partnerextra_leiras

The application uses the freely downloadable Partner Extra street and postcode
list for its own address suggestions and street-based location search. Street
names are normalized for lookup and combined into stable application records;
postcodes and Budapest districts are retained for disambiguation. The list is a
postal reference, not proof that an exact house number exists or is deliverable.
Exact property addresses are verified separately. Magyar Posta retains its
rights in the source; this notice does not claim an open-data licence.


Interactive neighborhood map
Display-only city layers are derived from the pinned neighborhood sources above;
the original full-resolution MySQL search boundaries remain unchanged.
Selectable place labels and selected-only municipal outlines are generated from
the same canonical catalogue and pinned OSM municipality/place-point sources.
Label points are display anchors, not property coordinates or address geocoding.
Municipality source compressed SHA-256:
fb5f1293628b9eeaabce243ae6ebc884f6bdc93443a2488e5fb213029bf766b7
OSM named-node source compressed SHA-256:
5c9193a72d4327e133f86d9c2625a4caeae3d21ec71d2575a3128b1d97931ecc

Basemap service: OpenFreeMap, https://openfreemap.org/
Interactive vector tiles, fonts and sprites: https://tiles.openfreemap.org/
Attribution: OpenFreeMap, © OpenMapTiles, Data from OpenStreetMap.
https://openmaptiles.org/ ; https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright
Map data remains subject to the OpenStreetMap ODbL terms above.

Changes: resolved the public tile-host placeholder; the application adds its
canonical selectable labels and filters duplicate Hungarian place labels at
runtime. Other background styling is retained.
Style code is derived under BSD-3-Clause terms; the OpenMapTiles design requires
attribution (CC BY 4.0), with upstream OSM Liberty/Mapbox design credits below.
OpenFreeMap-specific additions use the MIT licence below. These software/style
licences do not replace the map-data or compiled-catalogue terms above.

### Styles

#### Bright

Fork from [openmaptiles/osm-bright-gl-style](https://github.com/openmaptiles/osm-bright-gl-style). The OSM Bright GL Style is derived from [Mapbox Open Styles](https://github.com/mapbox/mapbox-gl-styles). The OSM Bright GL Style’s code is released under the [BSD 3-Clause License](<https://tldrlegal.com/license/bsd-3-clause-license-(revised)>). The OSM Bright GL Style’s design is released under [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). [LICENSE.md](https://github.com/openmaptiles/osm-bright-gl-style/blob/master/LICENSE.md).

#### Liberty

Fork from [maputnik/osm-liberty](https://github.com/maputnik/osm-liberty). OSM Liberty is a fork of OSM Bright. The OSM Bright GL Style is derived from [Mapbox Open Styles](https://github.com/mapbox/mapbox-gl-styles). The OSM Bright GL Style’s code is released under the [BSD 3-Clause License](<https://tldrlegal.com/license/bsd-3-clause-license-(revised)>). The OSM Bright GL Style’s design is released under [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). [LICENSE.md](https://github.com/maputnik/osm-liberty/blob/gh-pages/LICENSE.md).

#### Positron

Fork from [openmaptiles/positron-gl-style](https://github.com/openmaptiles/positron-gl-style). The Positron GL Style is derived from [CartoDB Basemaps](https://github.com/CartoDB/CartoDB-basemaps) designed by Stamen and Paul Norman for CartoDB Inc., licensed under [CC BY 3.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/). The Positron GL style’s code is released under the [BSD 3-Clause License](<https://tldrlegal.com/license/bsd-3-clause-license-(revised)>). The Positron GL Style’s design is released under [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). [LICENSE.md](https://github.com/openmaptiles/positron-gl-style/blob/master/LICENSE.md).

## Design License

The look and feel of the OSM liberty map design is also derived (although heavily altered) from [OSM Bright from Mapbox Open Styles](https://github.com/mapbox/mapbox-gl-styles/blob/master/LICENSE.md) which is licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 license.

The map is displaying and styling the data from [OpenMapTiles](https://openmaptiles.org/) with [CC-BY 4.0 design license](https://github.com/openmaptiles/openmaptiles/blob/master/LICENSE.md).

The products or services using this map style need to visibly credit "OpenMapTiles.org" or reference "OpenMapTiles" with a link to http://openmaptiles.org/. For a browsable electronic map based on OpenMapTiles and OpenStreetMap data, the credit should appear in the corner of the map. For example:

[© OpenMapTiles](https://openmaptiles.org/)
[© OpenStreetMap contributors](https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright)

For printed and static maps a similar attribution should be made in a textual description near the image, in the same fashion as if you cite a photograph.
